NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Feb-04-2016 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: his cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Gender Change and Issuance of New Birth Certificate.
Dept. 514, Judge: Joseph M. Quinn, Clerk: A. Mok, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840.

Petitioner: Lucio de la Loma Espiritu aka Lucio de la Loma present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined.
Declaration of Sworn Physician on file.

No objections to the proposed Change of Gender and Issuance of New Birth Certificate were made at the hearing.
The Court grants the Petition of Diana Santana Paz for Gender Change from male to female and Issuance of New Birth Certificate.

Order for Gender Change and Issuance of New Birth Certificate signed by the Court.
